'''Kral Grek''' was a [[Quarren]] [[Gender|male]] [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]] around the [[Standard year|year]] [[56 BBY]]. In [[22 BBY]], Grek was in the [[Uscru Entertainment District]] on the planet [[Coruscant]] when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] landed an [[XJ-6 airspeeder|airspeeder]] nearby. Grek's [[Thief|stolen]] identity profile was later used by the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] to test several potential employees of [[Ohnaka Transport Solutions]] in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the planet [[Batuu]] in [[34 ABY]].

==Biography==
Kral Grek was a [[Quarren]] [[Gender|male]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on<ref name="Datapad" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|mon-cala|Mon Cala}}</ref> [[Mon Cala]]<ref name="Datapad" /> around [[56 BBY]].<ref name="GEDates" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="AOTC Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Grek was on the planet [[Coruscant]] and was walking past the [[Outlander Club]] in the<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Uscru Entertainment District]]<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] landed his<ref name="AOTC" /> [[XJ-6 airspeeder]]<ref name="CVD" /> nearby while chasing the [[bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell]]. The [[Jedi]] then jumped out and ran toward Grek in the direction of the club's entrance.<ref name="AOTC" />

[[File:KralGrek-AOTC.png|thumb|left|200px|Kral Grek passes through the Uscru Entertainment District on Coruscant.]]
When Grek was 90 [[Standard year|years]] old, the Quarren's [[Thief|stolen]] identity profile was in the possession of the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]], owner of [[Ohnaka Transport Solutions]].<ref name="Datapad" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="GEDates" /> Ohnaka made use of the profile while planning a [[Heist on a First Order train|heist]] during the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]]. The pirate sent Grek's profile, along with several others, to the [[datapad]]s of several potential crew members for the heist in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on Batuu and had them memorize details from the profiles. He then quizzed the potential Ohnaka Transport Solutions employees on details from the profiles in order to test whether they were able to remember the necessary details of a cover identity.<ref name="Datapad" />

==Personality and traits==
Kral Grek weighed 165 [[pound]]s and stood 5 [[Foot|feet]], 11 inches tall. The Quarren had [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, no [[hair]],<ref name="Datapad" /> and orange skin.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Equipment==
Grek wore a gray [[Clothing|shirt]] and pants while on Coruscant.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kral Grek first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> The character was first named in the [[Star Wars: Datapad|''Star Wars'': Datapad]] app that launched alongside the themed land [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]],<ref name="Datapad" /> which opened to guests at [[Disneyland]] Park and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]] in [[2019]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=creatures-droids-and-aliens-meet-the-fantastical-figures-of-star-wars-galaxys-edge|text=Creatures, Droids, and Aliens: Meet the Fantastical Figures of ''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] name Kral meant "[[Spear/Legends|spear]]," and the archaic meaning of the Quarren surname Grek was "harvester of [[Kelp/Legends|kelp]]."<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
